How a lifecycle record becomes verified

  1. Select the exact exchange product and contract month from the official calendar.
  2. Record last trade date/time, notice and delivery/settlement dates that apply to that product.
  3. Reconcile product trading hours, breaks, holiday overrides and the current rule revision.
  4. Document a separate roll policy based on the intended use and permitted volume/open-interest evidence.
  5. Attach source, as-of date and reviewer; keep the family PARTIAL until every required field is supported.

The page links to exchange-maintained sources only. It does not scrape, cache or redistribute exchange data and does not infer expiry dates from generic weekday rules.
